_readme: Hand-edited. One entry per award given. scope = a league id ("FA26-L1") for league awards, or a season ("FA26") for season awards. award = one of the keys in src/lib/awards.ts (best_defender, og_award, ballon_dor, puskas; champion / golden_boot / playmaker are computed from the data, so for those only add a photo). winners = exact player names as on the players tab. photo (optional) = a trophy/ceremony photo under public/trophies/, resized to about 1200px. Example: {"scope": "FA26-L1", "award": "best_defender", "winners": ["홍길동"], "photo": "/trophies/fa26-l1-best-defender.jpg"}
